name: Prismatic HeroCel
purpose: Apply a person-agnostic polished animated-game rendering grammar to any approved likeness and canonical character design while preserving that subject's own face geometry, anatomy, age, and identity. Kineza is calibration evidence for the rendering grammar only, never a transferable likeness source.

styleDefinition.hybridDescription: feature-animation-informed facial readability + anime-influenced graphic simplification + broad cel-like value grouping + restrained painterly polish + high-detail fantasy game materials
styleDefinition.coreResult: A character should look like their own likeness transformed into a polished animated fantasy-game model, not like Kineza wearing a different costume.

calibrationMaster.selectedReference: second approved animated Kineza image from 2026-08-28 calibration review
calibrationMaster.selectionReason: Strongest example of the desired edge treatment, value grouping, detail hierarchy, material rendering, facial readability, and animation-ready finish.

identityFirewall.rule: Style authority may alter how a feature is rendered, never whose feature geometry is used.

ownership.hairGeometry: likenessAuthority or characterDesignAuthority when canonically altered

hardRejectExamples: A Prismel result that resembles Ezra/Kineza more than Elijah
An adult character inheriting Kineza's child face proportions
Any character receiving Kineza's grin, eye spacing, cheek contour, or head shape merely because Kineza is the style master

likenessTransitionEvidence.principle: Use the delta between authentic Kineza photos and approved Kineza animation only to infer non-identity rendering transformations. Never encode Kineza-specific geometry as a reusable style trait.
permittedInferences: how realistic skin gradients become broad readable value groups
how facial details are simplified without changing identity geometry
how FX gains clean negative space from anatomy

edgeTreatment.rule: Crisp controlled silhouette and internal material boundaries with selective softness only where light or atmosphere requires it.
edgeTreatment.face: clean feature separation without heavy comic inking
edgeTreatment.costume: clear layer separation at gameplay scale

valueGrouping.rule: Broad intentional light, midtone, and shadow masses replace photographic continuous gradients.
valueGrouping.skin: smooth dimensional volume with restrained transition bands

highlightTreatment.rule: Selective painterly polish on focal surfaces rather than uniform gloss.

detailHierarchy.rule: Large silhouette first, medium construction second, micro-detail last.
detailHierarchy.density: high detail may exist, but it must be clustered around focal design features instead of distributed uniformly.

materialRendering.rule: Graphic material identity first, texture second.

examples.metal: crisp edge planes and controlled specular accents
examples.fabric: readable folds with restrained weave noise
examples.crystal: faceted luminous geometry with clear silhouette
examples.skin: clean volume, no photoreal pore-level emphasis

facialRendering.rule: Simplify surface modeling while preserving the exact subject-owned feature geometry.
facialRendering.eyes: increase contrast, catchlight clarity, pupil/iris readability, and lid definition without borrowing Kineza eye size or shape
facialRendering.nose: simplify shading planes without changing nose width, tip family, bridge relationship, or placement
facialRendering.mouth: clean contour and shadow shapes without changing lip proportions or smile geometry
facialRendering.cheeksJawChin: simplify shading and contour noise without changing the subject's actual facial silhouette

requirements: readable eye direction at reduced scale
clear body silhouette independent of FX
costume layers retain identity across poses
expression remains legible without photoreal micro-detail
FX does not fuse with anatomy or erase hand/joint boundaries

fxGrammar.rule: Bold clean energy shapes with deliberate negative space from anatomy and props.

youngChild.geometryRule: All actual child facial geometry remains likeness-owned. Do not import Kineza proportions.

olderChild.facialReadability: high but more restrained than youngChild
olderChild.geometryRule: Preserve the subject's older-child geometry and maturity.

adult.geometryRule: Preserve mature brow, jaw, nose, eye spacing, and head proportions exactly.

portabilityContract.principle: HeroCel must work on an unrelated random character with a completely different face, age, body type, costume, and personality while still producing the same rendering-family read.
portabilityContract.passCondition: Observers can recognize a common art/rendering family without perceiving transferred Kineza facial anatomy.

translationContract.instruction: Render the approved subject and canonical design using the Prismatic HeroCel style-only fingerprint. Never use Kineza as a facial, anatomical, proportional, or expression reference for another character.

forbiddenDrift: photoreal face pasted onto stylized costume
pixel-art conversion when not explicitly requested
copying Kineza eye spacing or eye shape
copying Kineza cheek, nose, mouth, jaw, chin, ear, or head geometry
